name: Valentine Enterprises Inc
old_description: Valentine Enterprises specializes in custom powder formulation, blending, and packaging. Combining Scientific Expertise with high-quality manufacturing, Valentine brings your product vision to life.
about:
Valentine Enterprises operates a 400,000-square-foot, company-owned facility in Lawrenceville, Georgia, where it provides contract manufacturing services for powder-based nutritional products.

The company’s core services span product development, ingredient sourcing, validated mixing, and precision packaging. Its formulators and scientists work with brands to create or refine powder supplements, including protein powders, vitamins, and nutritional blends. Manufacturing follows straight-line precision processes under cGMP and HACCP standards, with allergen-controlled protocols and rigorous cleaning procedures. The facility supports turnkey projects that manage development, sourcing, production, and quality assurance from concept to finished goods.

Valentine serves brands in the dietary supplement, sports nutrition, and wellness markets. Its client base includes Fortune 100 and Fortune 500 companies as well as large protein-powder sellers. The company emphasizes proprietary, customer-specific formulations rather than private-label offerings, though it notes it is exploring private-label solutions.

Valentine differentiates itself through a set of core values that prioritize personal quality ownership, ethical decision-making, rapid response times, and commitment adherence. It also highlights its certification portfolio—NSF, cGMP, Organic, Kosher, HACCP, and FDA registration—as evidence of going beyond industry standards. Flavor development is cited as a particular passion and specialty.
